basics.name: Stanley Francis Ewenike
basics.label: Evaluation Senior Manager and Analytics Lead, Data Operations
basics.summary: Data Scientist with a PhD in Computer Science and over seven years applying machine learning, statistical modelling and advanced analytics across healthcare and enterprise domains. Skilled in Python, SQL and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for predictive models, record linkage and production data pipelines. Recent work at NHS England includes a reproducible record-linkage pipeline for 1,700+ programme participants and a common data model linking 7,000+ records across 13 datasets, backed by a research background in distributed and context-aware systems. Right to work in the UK (indefinite leave to remain); no visa sponsorship required.

work.name: NHS England, Innovation, Research, Life Sciences and Strategy
work.position: Evaluation Senior Manager and Analytics Lead, Data Operations
highlights: Built a tested record-linkage pipeline checking 1,700+ Clinical Entrepreneur Programme participants against company and funding registers, with byte-identical outputs across runs; identified and withdrew a survivorship-biased finding before publication
Built a common data model resolving 7,000+ records from 13 datasets across 6 innovation programmes, with tiered entity resolution, an 11-page Streamlit app and 42 automated tests
Built a 24-step Python pipeline and Streamlit dashboard that produce data quality, variation and strategic reports and 15 network data packs for the Health Innovation Networks from one command

Ran readiness assurance for all 15 Health Innovation Networks, achieving a full response after cutting the instrument from 22 questions to 6, and reported prioritised recommendations to the Steering and governance group
Apply statistical and machine learning models for trend analysis, classification and clustering to support strategic decisions
Architect ETL pipelines using SQL, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric for enterprise data harmonisation
Use generative AI and LLM copilots for code optimisation, faster development and automated documentation
